``` from mlx.utils import tree_map def all_reduce_grads(grads): N = mx.distributed.init().size() if N == 1: return grads return tree_map( lambda x: mx.distributed.all_sum(x) / N, grads ) def step(model, x, y): loss, grads = loss_grad_fn(model, x, y) grads = all_reduce_grads(grads) # <--- This line was added optimizer.update(model, grads) return loss ```

def step(model, x, y):
    loss, grads = loss_grad_fn(model, x, y)

    optimizer.update(model, grads)
    return loss

for x, y in dataset:
